messages:
Priya (marketing): planning announce for Optimize v2 next Thu 09:00 PT. need final changelog URL, docs quickstart, and a confirmed rollout cadence. can eng lock a safe window?
Sam (engineering): propose staged rollout with feature-flag gating: canary 05:45 PT, 25% at 07:00, 75% at 08:30, hold for manual go/no-go at 09:00. rollback on error spike >5% 5xx in 3m.
Priya (marketing): marketing will hold major mailers until we reach the 75% gate and manual go. we can run organic twitter and community posts earlier but no paid promos until green.
Alex (docs): docs PR open: https://docs.redwood.ai/pr/512 — changelog section has plain-language bullets and an example quickstart. will add an explicit migration note for prefix-cache params before merge.
Casey (devex): webinar locked with Heather at 10:00 PT. landing page URL draft: https://redwood.ai/webinar/optimize-v2-preview. need three succinct benefit lines for hero and a one-liner for the webinar intro.
Sam (engineering): benefit lines (draft): "handles long conversations ~2x faster for multi-turn apps", "reduces per-token spend by ~15-25% depending on workload", "keeps 95th pct tail latency under 120ms for 32k contexts". webinar one-liner: "See Optimize v2 live: speed and cost wins for long-context apps."
Priya (marketing): good. tweak the savings line to be non-committal: "reduces per-token spend by up to 20% for many workloads". also ask for a one-sentence caveat we can use in social copy.
Sam (engineering): updated: "reduces per-token spend by up to 20% for many workloads". caveat: "results depend on workload shape and traffic patterns; see benchmarks in the docs."
ReleaseBot: deploy window reserved: staging canary @ 2026-04-15T05:45:00Z, prod rollout start @ 2026-04-15T09:00:00Z. auto-rollback: sustained 5xx >5% for 3m.
Pager: Ops oncall will monitor rollout. I will post status pings at each gate and escalate if thresholds breach.
Alex (docs): merged changelog & quickstart: https://docs.redwood.ai/changelog/optimize-v2 and https://docs.redwood.ai/quickstart/optimize-v2. added migration snippet and a troubleshooting note.
Priya (marketing): excellent — marketing will circulate embargoed blog + social for approvals by EOD. day-of runbook summary: engineering: post gate status and immediate merge link (you); docs: verify redirects and code snippets (you); devex: webinar CTA + rehearsal (you); marketing: publish blog at 09:00 but hold mass sends until manual go at 09:00/green (me).
Sam (engineering): note: please avoid driving sudden spikes at 09:00 — well warm N seconds of traffic but prefer ramped promos until 09:10.
Priya (marketing): acknowledged. well sequence mailers starting 09:10 and hold paid promos until 09:20. thanks all — ill post the final runbook here tomorrow morning. :rocket:
